violations.text: Raw animal foods (eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (produce) in the refrigerators. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

The reach-in in the main area was observed at 50 degrees. Unit to not be used for TCS foods until serviced. Unit was observed at 35 degrees in the morning per temp logs. Establishment to send inspector proof of service. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the shelving in the corner of the store have an accumulation of rodent droppings. PIC stated area will be cleaned and pest control will be called. PIC to monitor area. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2024
